integrity: Independent mathematical reconstruction establishes the exact positive-square derivative identity and the four strict rational-interval sign certificates; these prove two unique transition ratios using the 2007 root-type theorem. Published 2009 cone calculations and the earlier 2007 general criterion are credited. This is mathematical review, not Lean formalization or external expert attestation.
scientific_limitations: Right circular cones only, t=h/r>0; no degenerate/oblique/truncated cones or individual closed-form roots. The upper transition ≈3.37108 and qualitative three-regime occurrence are prior literature; new claimed scope is the complete monotone two-threshold theorem and exact real-root window. The complete relevant 2008 thesis was inaccessible in the current comparison, so historical originality remains best-of-knowledge.
title: Complete two-transition Steiner-root phase diagram for right circular cones
